title: Battery Coolant Control
text: Battery coolant control algorithm, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Algorithm data type} sets Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit:; {Specify CellTemperature input as [Min,Max]} sets the option to specify CellTemperature input as minimum and maximum, {Control strategy}, {Switch-on temperature} sets the coolant switch-on temperature, {Switch-off temperature} sets the coolant switch-off temperature, {Constant used in f(deltaT)=c*deltaT} sets the constant for coolant strategy and {Flow rate step}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Specify CellTemperature input as [Min,Max]
params.values: Option to specify CellTemperature input as minimum and maximum values off (default) | on

params.name: Control strategy
params.values: Control strategy ON-OFF control (default) | Step control

params.name: Constant used in f(deltaT)=c*deltaT
params.values: Constant for coolant strategy 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
